title: Login Authentication Debugging
description: The demo app rejects some valid logins and accepts some invalid ones. Trace the request flow and repair its authentication logic.
objective: Correct credential checking and input handling while preserving safe, consistent failure behavior.
expectedBehavior: login/authenticate accept optional<string>. Nullopt represents invalid/missing input. Normalize usernames only; passwords are exact and only active users may log in. Do not change USERS.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
